title: Unsigned customer_auth Cookie Allows Customer Account Impersonation
description: The customer_auth cookie stores raw customer.id without any HMAC or JWT signature. Endpoints /api/auth/customer/me and /api/customer/* trust the raw cookie value directly as the authenticated customerId.
rootCause: No cryptographic session signing implemented for customer authentication.
impact: Any attacker can set cookie customer_auth=<customer_cuid> to view or modify any customer profile, password, notifications, and appointments.
remediation: Sign customer session tokens with HMAC-SHA256 (similar to signAdminToken) using a dedicated secret and verify the signature in a shared getCustomerFromRequest() helper.

title: Unauthenticated Legacy CRUD APIs Expose Customer PII and Allow Price/Booking Tampering
description: Routes /api/appointments, /api/appointments/[id], /api/barbers (POST), /api/barbers/[id] (GET/PUT/DELETE), /api/services (POST), and /api/services/[id] (PUT/DELETE) have zero authentication or authorization checks.
rootCause: Legacy REST endpoints were left exposed without authorizeAdmin() guards.
impact: Unauthenticated callers can dump all customer phones, names, emails, and birth dates, change service prices to 1 Toman, confirm unpaid appointments, or delete salon records.
remediation: Add authorizeAdmin(request, 'OWNER') to mutating service/barber endpoints and authorizeAdmin(request) to /api/appointments* (or remove unused legacy routes).

title: Hardcoded Fallback JWT/HMAC Secret Allows Admin Token Forgery
description: Both lib/auth.ts (line 12) and lib/edge-auth.ts (lines 14-17) fall back to the hardcoded literal 'koroush-barber-luxury-secret-key-2026' if ADMIN_JWT_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are unset.
rootCause: Insecure fallback secret committed into repository source code.
impact: If environment secrets are missing in any deployment, attackers can forge valid OWNER admin session cookies.
remediation: Throw an error on startup in NODE_ENV=production if ADMIN_JWT_SECRET is missing or shorter than 32 bytes.

title: Admin Login Page Exposes and Pre-fills Demo Credentials in Production
description: Admin login UI pre-fills admin/admin123456 and renders clickable quick-select demo credential buttons (admin/admin123456 and staff/staff123456) regardless of NODE_ENV.
rootCause: Missing environment guard around development convenience UI.
impact: Exposes default credentials publicly on the production /admin-login page.
remediation: Guard demo credential buttons and pre-filled state behind an explicit non-production environment flag.

title: Missing IP Rate Limiting on OTP Send Endpoint Enables SMS Pumping
description: POST /api/booking/otp/send only enforces a 2-minute cooldown per phone number, with no IP-based rate limiting.
rootCause: checkRateLimit() from lib/rate-limit.ts was not applied to OTP sending.
impact: Attackers can send OTP SMS to thousands of distinct Iranian phone numbers, exhausting Kavenegar SMS balance.
remediation: Enforce strict IP-based rate limiting (e.g., max 5 requests per IP per 10 minutes) in addition to per-phone cooldown.

title: Non-Constant-Time HMAC Signature Comparison
description: verifyAdminToken and verifyAdminTokenEdge compare HMAC signatures using !== instead of constant-time comparison.
rootCause: Standard string inequality used on cryptographic digests.
impact: Theoretical timing side-channel against HMAC token verification.
remediation: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length Buffers in lib/auth.ts.

title: Weak 5-Digit Tracking Code Entropy and Unthrottled Cancel Endpoint
description: Tracking codes use only 5 numeric digits (KB-10000..99999, 90,000 combinations), and POST /api/booking/cancel has no rate limiting.
rootCause: Small numeric tracking space and missing checkRateLimit on cancel route.
impact: Tracking codes can be enumerated; if a customer phone is known, bookings can be cancelled without OTP verification.
remediation: Increase tracking code entropy (e.g., 8 alphanumeric chars) and enforce IP rate limiting on /api/booking/cancel.

title: Open Redirect via Unvalidated callback Query Parameter in Mock Payment Page
description: searchParams.get('callback') is passed directly to new URL(callbackUrl, window.location.origin) and assigned to window.location.href.
rootCause: Missing same-origin validation on callback URL.
impact: Allows external phishing redirects if mock payment page is accessible.
remediation: Verify targetUrl.origin === window.location.origin before redirecting.

title: Nginx Static Asset Location Blocks Drop Parent Security Headers and Lack CSP/Rate-Limiting
description: Nginx add_header Cache-Control directives inside /_next/static/ and image/font regex locations override parent server-level security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff). No CSP or limit_req_zone configured.
rootCause: Nginx add_header directive inheritance drops parent headers when child block defines add_header.
impact: Static asset responses omit HSTS/nosniff headers; edge layer lacks rate limiting.
remediation: Include shared security headers snippet inside static location blocks and add Nginx limit_req_zone for /api/.

title: Dev Docker Compose Exposes PostgreSQL Port with Default Password
description: docker-compose.yml binds 5432:5432 on all interfaces and defaults DB_PASSWORD and ADMIN_JWT_SECRET to static strings.
rootCause: Developer convenience defaults in root docker-compose.yml.
impact: If accidentally used in production instead of compose.production.yml, PostgreSQL and weak secrets are exposed.
remediation: Bind PostgreSQL port to 127.0.0.1:5432 in docker-compose.yml.

title: Deposit Calculation Mismatch in Payment Initiation Endpoint
description: pay/route.ts computes depositAmount = appointment.service.depositPrice || 50000, ignoring service.depositType === 'percentage' and service.depositPercent used in reserveSlotHold().
rootCause: Duplicated pricing calculation logic out of sync with lib/booking-engine.ts.
impact: Customer can be quoted one deposit amount on hold/invoice and charged a different amount at ZarinPal/Mock gateway.
remediation: Extract a shared computeServiceDeposit(service) helper and use it in both booking-engine.ts and pay/route.ts.

title: Admin Reschedule Logs Fake SENT SMS Without Invoking SMS Provider
description: Inserts a NotificationJob record with status: 'SENT' and hardcoded provider: 'SMS_IR' without calling getSmsProvider().
rootCause: Placeholder notification DB write left inside reschedule transaction.
impact: Customers never receive SMS notifications when rescheduled by admin, while SMS Center logs falsely report SENT.
remediation: Dispatch SMS via getSmsProvider().sendCustomSms() after transaction commit and record the real delivery result.

title: Booking Hold Race Condition Under PostgreSQL ReadCommitted Isolation
description: prisma.$transaction uses default ReadCommitted isolation in PostgreSQL without a DB-level partial unique index on active SlotHold or confirmed Appointment.
rootCause: Check-then-insert pattern relies on SQLite file write locking which does not serialize concurrent reads in PostgreSQL ReadCommitted.
impact: Concurrent PostgreSQL requests for the same slot can both pass findFirst() and create overlapping active holds.
remediation: Use Serializable transaction isolation (with P2034 retry) or PostgreSQL partial unique indexes on active holds and confirmed slots.

title: External SMS HTTP Call Inside Database Transaction Risks Payment Rollback
description: await sms.sendBookingConfirmation() executes inside prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => ...).
rootCause: External network I/O placed inside ACID database transaction boundary.
impact: Slow Kavenegar responses (>5s) can exceed Prisma interactive transaction timeout, rolling back a bank-verified appointment confirmation.
remediation: Commit the CONFIRMED appointment and Payment update first, then dispatch SMS outside the transaction.

title: Payment Initiation Does Not Verify Hold Ownership or Terminal Appointment States
description: pay/route.ts only guards against status === 'CONFIRMED' (allowing CANCELLED/EXPIRED) and queries SlotHold without matching customerPhone.
rootCause: Incomplete state validation and missing customerPhone filter on SlotHold.
impact: Cancelled or expired appointments could initiate payment if another user holds the same slot.
remediation: Require appointment.status in ['HELD', 'AWAITING_PAYMENT'] and filter SlotHold by customerPhone.

title: Customer Dashboard Layout Renders Infinite Spinner When Unauthenticated
description: When /api/auth/customer/me returns 401, isLoggedIn remains false and CustomerLayout renders a spinner forever instead of redirecting to /auth.
rootCause: Missing router.replace('/auth') in checkAuth().
impact: Unauthenticated users visiting /dashboard* see an infinite loading screen.
remediation: Redirect unauthenticated users to /auth inside checkAuth().

title: Customer Portal Cancellation Bypasses 12-Hour Cutoff Policy and Leaves SlotHold Active
description: Unlike /api/booking/cancel, PATCH /api/customer/appointments/[id] does not enforce cancellation_cutoff_hours and does not release SlotHold.
rootCause: Duplicated, inconsistent cancellation logic across endpoints.
impact: Customers logged into /dashboard can bypass the 12-hour cancellation policy.
remediation: Extract and share a single cancelAppointment() domain function.

title: Automated SMS Reminders and Birthday Greetings Have No Background Worker or Cron
description: Admin SMS Center configures automatic appointmentReminder and birthdayGreeting rules, but no worker or cron script exists in the repo to trigger them.
rootCause: Configuration UI built without scheduled execution backend.
impact: Automated reminders and birthday SMS do not send automatically.
remediation: Add a secured cron API endpoint or worker container scheduled via systemd/cron.

title: WorkingHour Table Ignored by Public Slot Availability Engine
description: getAvailabilityForDate always generates 10:00-22:00 slots via hardcoded constants and ignores WorkingHour rows in the database.
rootCause: Hardcoded OPERATING_START_HOUR/END_HOUR instead of querying WorkingHour.
impact: Weekly working hour adjustments in WorkingHour do not affect public booking availability.
remediation: Read WorkingHour for the requested dayOfWeek with fallback to 10:00-23:00.

title: Missing Referenced Public Images and Inconsistent Salon Domain/Address Metadata
description: References /og-image.jpg, /images/service-full.jpg, /images/service-haircut.jpg which do not exist in public/. Domain alternates between koroushbarber.ir and kouroshbarber.ir; address differs between lib/ics.ts and app/page.tsx.
rootCause: Unaligned seed and metadata constants.
impact: 404 on OpenGraph image and inconsistent salon address in .ics calendar files.
remediation: Provide missing images or use existing SVGs, and centralize salon metadata.

title: Missing Network Timeouts and Non-JSON Guards on ZarinPal and Kavenegar HTTP Calls
description: fetch() calls to ZarinPal and Kavenegar omit AbortSignal.timeout and call res.json() without checking res.ok or content-type.
rootCause: Raw fetch() calls without resilience wrappers.
impact: Hanging upstream gateway can tie up Node worker connections; non-JSON 502 responses throw unhandled exceptions.
remediation: Add AbortSignal.timeout(10000) and safe response parsing around all external HTTP calls.

title: In-Memory Rate Limiter and Unbounded Mock Provider Stores
description: Rate limiting uses a process-local Map with un-unref()d setInterval; MockSmsProviderImpl.sentMessages grows unbounded in memory.
rootCause: In-memory single-process storage.
impact: Rate limits do not share across multiple instances; memory grows unbounded if MOCK mode runs long-term.
remediation: Bound mock message arrays and use Redis or Nginx rate limiting for multi-instance deployments.

title: Duplicate Unused BookingWizard Component and Monolithic Client Components
description: BookingWizard.tsx (37KB) duplicates booking flow alongside BookingStudio.tsx (67KB); admin/page.tsx (77KB) and admin/sms/page.tsx (78KB) are oversized single-file client components.
rootCause: Iterative feature additions without extracting subcomponents.
impact: Higher maintenance complexity and larger client JS chunks.
remediation: Split BookingStudio, admin/page.tsx, and admin/sms/page.tsx into modular subcomponents and remove unused BookingWizard.

title: Missing ESLint Configuration Causes npm run lint to Fail Interactively
description: Running npm run lint prompts interactively for ESLint configuration and exits with code 1 because no .eslintrc.json exists.
rootCause: ESLint config file was never committed.
impact: Automated CI linting cannot execute non-interactively.
remediation: Add .eslintrc.json extending 'next/core-web-vitals'.
